blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at this repository .
blocks.zh: 近期4D LiDAR语言模型旨在解释物体及其演变中的空间关系. 然而,在我们的评价中,总是选择同样的选项,几乎与两个B4DL衍生配置的多选精度一致。 我们介绍LiDAR-Hallu,一种几何参照基准和诊断协议,涉及150个nuScens场景的10,000个问题。 它涵盖了对象存在,自我相对位置,距离顺序,相对运动,以及时间定位,有选择对象,比较时间,确定参考答案的明确规则. 我们的协议结合了固定答案和候选内容控制,交叉场景对子和相同的提示但相反的参考答案,以及针对特定关系的召回. 对100 000份已记录的答复进行分析后发现,以总的准确性来掩盖失败。 仅候选人持续时间就可以在不观察LiDAR的情况下预测时间答案。 在对齐的问题上,模型经常对需要相反答案的场景给出相同的答案. 关系特异性分析进一步显示,两种配置都错过了所有测试条件的每个阳性横向运动案例. 临时调整的对比解码没有多少净改进,因为修复工作在很大程度上被新的错误所抵消,而且主要故障依然存在。 这些结果表明,评估spatio-时空推理需要测试模型是否区分被询问的物理关系,而不是仅依靠个人回答的准确性. 源代码、检查站和数据都在这个仓库中发布。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous driving requires understanding where surrounding objects are and how they move relative to the ego vehicle [ 1 ] . Decisions about yielding, passing, and maintaining separation depend on which obstacle is closest, whether another vehicle is approaching, and when an event occurs [ 2 ] . Recent methods connect LiDAR observations with language to support scene understanding [ 3 , 4 ] , while question-answering benchmarks assess these capabilities. Such judgments require more than recognizing objects. Determining whether a car is approaching requires following the same car and comparing its distance to the ego vehicle over the specified interval.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶需要了解周围物体的位置以及它们相对于自我飞行器的移动方式[1]. 有关屈服、通过和保持分离的决定取决于哪些障碍最接近、是否有另一载体接近以及何时发生[2]。 最近的方法将LiDAR观测与语言连接起来,支持场景理解[3,4],而问答基准则评估这些能力. 此类判决要求的不仅仅是识别对象。 确定一辆车是否接近,需要跟随同一辆车,并在规定的间隔时间内将其距离与自负车进行比较.

blocks.en: B4DL [ 5 ] extends LiDAR-language modeling to point-cloud sequences, providing a benchmark and an accompanying model for spatial and temporal question answering. However, average accuracy can conceal systematic errors. Figure (a) shows two questions about the same car over the same interval, asking whether it is moving back or forward relative to the ego vehicle. The reference answers are “Yes” and “No”, but the model answers “No” to both. It answers one question correctly while missing the motion identified by the reference. Panel (b) holds the question fixed and changes the scene: the reference answer changes, but the model again answers “No” to both. In multiple-choice questions (MCQ), always selecting “A” nearly matches the accuracy of the two B4DL-derived configurations evaluated here. Panel (c) shows this fixed-option behavior across spatial and temporal tasks.
blocks.zh: B4DL [5]将LiDAR语言模型扩展至点云序列,为时空问题回答提供了基准和配套模型. 然而,平均准确性可以掩盖系统性错误. 图(a)显示了关于同一车次的两个问题,询问该车相对于自负车是往后还是往前移动。 参考回答是“是”和“否”,但模型回答是“否”。 它正确地回答了一个问题,同时忽略了引用中确定的动议. 小组(b) 将问题固定下来,并改变场景:参考答案改变,但模型再次回答“不”。 在多个选择问题(MCQ)中,总是选择“A”几乎与本文评价的两个B4DL衍生配置的准确性相符。 (c) 面板显示这种跨越空间和时间任务的固定选择行为。

blocks.en:
Evaluation must therefore examine both answers that are predictable without the scene and relations that a model fails to distinguish. Existing driving benchmarks cover object-centric questions [ 6 ] , perception and planning [ 2 ] , spatial measurements [ 7 ] , and cross-view temporal reasoning [ 8 ] . In static 3D question answering, text-only models can match or exceed 3D models on SQA3D [ 9 ] .
Testing for answer biases is therefore only a first step, as it reveals whether predictions can be driven by textual or distributional cues without observing the scene. We further use paired questions and relation-specific recall to test whether the model actually distinguishes the physical relations that determine the correct answer.
blocks.zh:
因此,评价必须审查没有场景的可预测答案和模型无法区分的关系。 现有的驱动基准涵盖以物体为中心的问题[6],感知和规划[2],空间测量[7],以及交叉视时间推理[8]. 在静态3D问答中,仅文本模型可以在SQA3D[9]上匹配或超过3D模型.
因此,测试答案偏差只是第一步,因为它揭示了预测是否可以由文字或分布提示驱动而无需观察场景. 我们进一步使用配对问题和特定关系召回来测试模型是否实际区分了决定正确答案的物理关系.

blocks.en: We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes [ 1 ] . Its five task families cover existence, position, distance, motion, and event timing. Each family specifies the queried entities, relevant times, coordinate frame, and answer rule. The first four derive answers from nuScenes annotations. Temporal localization retains B4DL’s event intervals and adds three distractors (Figure 2 ). Table I compares this combination of sequence question answering and diagnostic evaluation with prior benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍LiDAR-Hallu, 一个基准和诊断协议, 它的五个任务范围包括存在、位置、距离、运动和活动时间。 每个家庭都具体说明被询问的实体、相关时间、协调框架和回答规则。 前四句从nuScens说明中得出答案. Timoral localization 保留了 B4DL 的事件间隔,并添加了三个分心器(图2 ). 图表 我将这种序列问题回答和诊断评估的组合与先前的基准进行比较。

blocks.en: We evaluate two B4DL-derived configurations under five inference settings, obtaining 100,000 responses to the same 10,000 questions. Three questions guide the study: RQ1. What can be answered without observing LiDAR? We measure fixed-answer performance and predict answers from questions and candidate text using statistics from other scenes. RQ2. Can models distinguish opposite physical relations? We measure joint correctness on exact-prompt cross-scene pairs and positive recall for individual relations. RQ3. Can inference-time interventions correct these errors? We evaluate anti-position prompting and Temporal-Shuffle Contrastive Decoding (TSCD), counting repaired and newly introduced errors separately. Our contributions are threefold: • A 10,000-question LiDAR benchmark with five task families, explicit reference-answer rules, and executable integrity checks. • A diagnostic protocol combining answer-bias controls, exact-prompt pairs, relation-specific recall, and paired correction analysis. • An analysis of 100,000 responses that identifies fixed-answer behavior, systematic relation omissions, and the limited benefit of the tested inference-time interventions.
blocks.zh: 我们在五个推论设置下评价两个B4DL衍生配置,获得10万个相同问题的答复. 三个问题指导研究: RQ1. 不观察LiDAR有什么可以回答的? 我们利用其他场景的统计数据,衡量固定答案的性能,并预测问题和候选文本的答案。 RQ2 (英语). 模型能否区分相反的物理关系? 我们衡量准确的瞬间交叉场景对齐的共同正确性,以及个人关系的积极召回。 RQ3(英语:RQ3. 推断时间干预能否纠正这些错误? 我们评估了反位置催化和临时反冲解码(TSCD),分别计算已修复和新引入的错误。 我们的贡献有三个方面:一个10 000个问题LiDAR基准,包括五个任务家庭,明确的参考答案规则,以及可执行的诚信检查。 • 支助 诊断协议,结合答比控件,精确的瞬间对对,关系特定召回和对对对的校正分析. 分析10万个答复,找出固定的回答行为,系统的关系疏漏,以及经测试的推论时间干预的有限好处.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Driving-scene question answering. NuScenes-QA generates questions about object existence, counts, states, and spatial relations from annotated scene graphs [ 6 ] . DriveLM links perception, prediction, and planning through graph-structured questions [ 2 ] . LingoQA evaluates scene descriptions, anticipation, and action justification in driving videos [ 10 ] , while DriveGPT4 combines video question answering and action explanations with vehicle-control prediction [ 11 ] . NuScenes-SpatialQA focuses on qualitative spatial relations and quantitative measurements [ 7 ] , and DriveSpatial examines cross-view and temporal reasoning [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 驾驶场问题回答 NuScenes-QA从注解的场景图中生成关于物体存在,计数,状态和空间关系的问题[6]. 驱动 LM通过图结构问题将感知,预测和规划联系起来[2]. 灵戈 QA在驾驶视频时评价场景描述,预期,和行动理由[10],而DriveGPT4则将视频问题回答和行动解释与车辆控制预测[11]相结合. 裸摄-空间 QA注重质量空间关系和定量测量[7],DriveSpaceal则研究交叉视角和时间推理[8].

blocks.en: LiDAR-language modeling. LidarCLIP aligns automotive point clouds with CLIP embeddings for retrieval and cross-modal applications [ 3 ] . LiDAR-LLM connects point clouds to captioning, question answering, and planning through a view-aware transformer and staged training [ 4 ] . B4DL extends this setting to sequences, with spatial reasoning, temporal localization, and scene-dynamics tasks [ 5 ] . LiDAR-Hallu builds on this setting with explicit geometric reference rules and tests whether answers distinguish the corresponding relations, as shown in Table I .
blocks.zh: LiDAR语言建模. LidarCLIP 将汽车点云与 CLIP 嵌入相配合,用于检索和跨模式应用 [3]. LiDAR-LLM将点云连接到字幕,提问回答,并通过一个能感知到的变压器和舞台训练来进行规划[4]. B4DL将这个设置扩展到序列,带有空间推理,时间定位,场景动力学任务[5]. LiDAR-Hallu基于这一设定,有明确的几何参考规则,并测试答案是否区分了相应的关系,见表一。

blocks.zh: 表格 一:驾驶-现场语言基准:传感器输入、时间覆盖和诊断评价。 数据集特征遵循B4DL的表1 [5]. 诊断栏显示报告的评价。

blocks.en: Answer biases and relational evaluation. VQA v2 pairs identical questions with complementary images requiring different answers [ 12 ] , while VQA-CP changes question-conditioned answer distributions between training and testing [ 13 ] . NuScenes-QA and LingoQA include question-only or text-only baselines [ 6 , 10 ] . Real-3DQA studies textual shortcuts in 3D question answering and filters questions readily answered without 3D input [ 9 ] . Multiple-choice studies also identify option-order sensitivity and weaknesses in binding answer symbols to candidates [ 14 , 15 ] . Our protocol measures fixed-answer behavior and candidate-content predictability separately, then tests joint correctness under identical complete prompts and opposite reference answers.
blocks.zh: 回答偏见和关系评价。 VQA v2 相同的问题与互补的图像需要不同的答案[12],而VQA-CP 则在培训与测试之间改变问题-有条件的答案分布[13]. NuScenes-QA和LingoQA包括只提问或只文本的基线[6,10]. 实值 3 DQA研究3D问题回答中的文字快捷键,并过滤不需3D输入即可轻易回答的问题[9]. 多重选择研究还确定了选项顺序敏感性和对候选人绑定答案符号的弱点[14,15]. 我们的协议分别衡量固定的回答行为和候选内容的可预测性,然后在完全相同的提示和相反的参考答案下测试联合正确性.

blocks.en: Diagnostic benchmarks and mitigation. Winoground and ARO test compositional, attribute, and relation distinctions [ 16 , 17 ] . Beacon3D examines object-centric descriptions and agreement between grounding and question answering [ 18 ] . 4D-Bench and Spatial4D-Bench address dynamic objects and spatio-temporal reasoning [ 19 , 20 ] . CHAIR, POPE, and AMBER assess unsupported object and relational claims [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] , while VidHalluc and EventHallusion study temporal and event-level errors [ 24 , 25 ] . We measure both false assertions and missed true relations in LiDAR sequences. For correction, visual and temporal contrastive decoding methods compare predictions from original and perturbed inputs [ 26 , 25 ] . We adapt temporal shuffling to LiDAR features and measure whether its repairs outweigh the errors it introduces.
blocks.zh: 诊断基准和缓解。 Winoground和ARO测试组成、属性和关系区别[16、17]。 Beacon3D研究了以物体为中心的描述和地面与问答之间的一致[18]. 4D-Bench和Space4D-Bench处理动态物体和时空推理[19,20]. [21、22、23],而VidHalluc和EventHallusion则研究时间和事件一级错误[24、25]。 我们在LiDAR序列中衡量虚假的断言和错失真实的关系. 对于校正,视觉和时间对比的解码方法比较了原始和扰动输入的预测[26,25]. 我们适应LiDAR的特性,并测量其修复是否超过它引入的错误。

blocks.en: III-B Question construction
blocks.zh: 三-B 问题建筑

blocks.en: Object existence. Binary questions ask whether a class is present at a specified keyframe, with 500 positive and 500 negative examples. Each of the 1,000 multiple-choice questions contains one present class and three absent classes.
blocks.zh: 对象存在. 二进制问题询问在指定的键框中是否存在一个类,有500个正例和500个负例. 1000个多选题中每个都包含一个现班和三个缺席班.

blocks.en: Ego-relative position. We assign the nearest instance of the queried class to one of eight 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} bearing sectors: front, front-left, left, back-left, back, back-right, right, and front-right. Binary questions balance correct and incorrect proposed sectors. Multiple-choice questions contain the reference sector and three alternatives.
blocks.zh: 依果相对位. 我们把最近一个被问到的类划为八个45个区之一:前、前、左、后、后、右和前。 二元问题平衡了拟议部门的正确和不正确。 多重选择问题包括参考部门和三种选择。

blocks.en:
Architecture and inputs. We evaluate B4DL and B4DL-Ego, two B4DL-derived checkpoints instruction-tuned separately on B4DL’s nuScenes-based data [ 5 ] . Both use a learned projector to map cached LiDAR-CLIP features [ 3 ] into Vicuna-1.5-7B token embeddings, as shown in Figure 4 .
B4DL takes LiDAR features and question text as input, while B4DL-Ego also receives ego-motion text. All questions, including single-frame queries, use the full scene sequence of 39–41 feature steps in temporal order. Ego-motion text summarizes ego speed, displacement direction, heading change, and acceleration from local pose changes at two selected endpoints. The enclosing span is determined by all frame intervals in the prompt, including those in the answer choices. Single-frame queries use a five-frame window adjusted at scene boundaries, while prompts without frame indices use the scene endpoints. Neither model receives object annotations or reference answers at inference.

建筑与投入. 我们评价B4DL和B4DL-Ego, 两个B4DL衍生的检查站指示, 如图4所示,两者均使用学习的投影仪将缓存的LiDAR-CLIP特性[3]映射到维库纳-1.5-7B符号嵌入.
B4DL将LiDAR的特性和质疑文本作为输入,而B4DL-Ego也接收自动机文本. 所有问题,包括单帧查询,都按时间顺序使用39–41的全场特征步骤. ego-motion文本总结了自我速度,转移方向,标题变化,以及从局部的加速度在两个选定的终点上的变化. 附加间距由所有框间隔,包括答案选择中的间隔决定。 单帧查询使用场景边界调整的五帧窗口,而没有帧指数的提示则使用场景终点. 两个模型都得不到对象说明或推断的参考答案.

blocks.en: Training configuration. The archived training configuration specifies one epoch of projector alignment at a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} , followed by two epochs of Vicuna instruction tuning at 10 − 4 10^{-4} with the projector frozen. Instruction tuning uses LoRA with rank 64 and α LoRA = 128 \alpha_{\mathrm{LoRA}}=128 , combining B4DL’s stage-2 and stage-3 records with ego-motion text added for B4DL-Ego. Alignment utilizes a per-GPU batch size of 16 with eight gradient-accumulation steps, while instruction tuning applies a per-GPU batch size of eight with 16 accumulation steps. Both stages use fixed cached features, FP16, cosine learning-rate decay, 3% warmup, zero weight decay, and a 2,048-token context limit.

blocks.en: Multiple-choice accuracy largely follows a fixed answer. Under default decoding, both models remain within 1.70 percentage points of constant A across the four MCQ tasks as in Table III . Both select A in more than 96% of distance-ordering and temporal-localization responses, constraining their accuracy differences from constant A, per Eq. ( 4 ).

blocks.en: The margins are larger on binary existence questions, i.e., B4DL and B4DL-Ego achieve 66.30% and 67.20% accuracy, respectively, compared with 50.00% for constant No. B4DL-Ego produces more varied spatial-position answers, but achieves 27.00% , compared with 26.10% for B4DL.

blocks.en: Candidate contents remain informative. The scene-held-out controls, in Table III , are fitted using reference labels from the other benchmark scenes as in Sec. IV . Candidate class names yield 66.10% accuracy on existence MCQs and 52.70% on distance ordering. Although every distance candidate is present in the scene, its class remains informative about whether it is the nearest object.

blocks.en: Individual accuracy hides failed contrasts. On 348 exact-prompt pairs with opposite reference answers, B4DL achieves 53.30% accuracy on individual questions but answers both questions correctly in only 43 pairs as in Table IV . Most pairs receive identical answers, and only one of the 41 spatial-postion pairs is jointly correct. A deterministic prompt-only predictor has zero joint correctness on these pairs, although sampling can produce nonzero joint correctness without scene information.
blocks.zh: 个人准确性隐藏失败的对比 。 在348个有相反参考答案的精确瞬间对子上,B4DL在单个问题上实现了53.30%的精确度,但如表四所示,两个问题只在43对中正确回答. 大多数对子都得到相同的答案,41个空间-后置对子中只有一个是共同对的. 确定性的即时唯一预测器在这些配对上具有0联合正确性,尽管采样在没有场景信息的情况下可以产生非0联合正确性.

Anti-position prompting and TSCD improves yield 39 and 40–42 jointly correct B4DL pairs, respectively, compared with 43 under default decoding. On the separate 38-pair B4DL-Ego set, four pairs are jointly correct with TSCD, compared with two under default decoding, while most pairs remain unresolved.
Each configuration is compared across inference settings on its own fixed pair set.

反位促进和TSCD分别提高产量39和40–42联合校正B4DL对,而默认解码下则为43对. 在单独的38pair B4DL-Ego套装上,四对与TSCD共同校正,而默认解码下两对,而大多数配对仍未解决.
每种配置在自己的固定对集上进行跨推论设置的比较.

blocks.en: Table V explains why motion accuracy alone gives an incomplete picture. Both models answer No to every left- and right-motion question under all evaluated settings. All 302 positive lateral-motion cases are missed. The corresponding accuracies of 57.85% and 58.47% equal the proportions of negative examples, with zero positive recall for both predicates.
blocks.zh: 表五解释了为何仅运动精度就给出了不完整的图片. 两个模型都回答 在所有评估的设置下,对每一个左右运动问题都表示反对。 所有302个阳性横向运动病例均被错过。 相应的57.85%和58.47%的速率与负面例子的比例相等,两个上游都零正召回.

Recall also varies between distance-change predicates, i.e., closer recall is below 8% for both models, whereas farther recall is 30.26% for B4DL and 7.20% for B4DL-Ego. Recall for the predefined Similar predicate is higher, at 55.86% and 61.38%, respectively,
indicating relation-specific errors.

距离变化上游的召回率也各不相同,即两个模型的召回率都低于8%,而B4DL的召回率为30.26%,B4DL-Ego为7.20%。 回顾预先定义的类似上游值较高,分别为55.86%和61.38%,

blocks.en: Table VI reveals that B4DL-Ego has a lower false-positive rate than B4DL on binary existence questions, but also lower positive recall. The reduction in false assertions outweighs the increase in missed positive claims, yielding accuracies of 67.20% and 66.30%, respectively. False assertions are more frequent on position questions, where false-positive rates are 78.40% for B4DL and 74.80% for B4DL-Ego.
blocks.zh: 表六显示,在二进制存在问题上,B4DL-Ego的假阳性率低于B4DL,但也低于正反复录. 虚假主张的减少超过了错失的肯定主张的增加,分别达到67.20%和66.30%。 立场问题上的虚假断言更为常见,B4DL的虚假阳性率为78.40%,B4DL-Ego的虚假阳性率为74.80%.

blocks.en: V-E RQ3: Do inference-time changes repair errors?

blocks.zh: 表七:干预结果不佳。 R/D R/D:修理/后退。 准确性变化和95%的场景-坡度间隔以百分点计。 提示表示反位置提示.

blocks.en:
Relative to default decoding, TSCD accuracy gains are 0.03–0.04 percentage points for B4DL and 0.15–0.19 for B4DL-Ego (Table VII ). All six 95% scene-bootstrap confidence intervals include zero. For B4DL-Ego at α = 1.5 \alpha=1.5 , 161 errors are corrected but 142 previously correct answers become incorrect, leaving a net gain of 19 out of 10,000 questions.
The dominant failures are unchanged: temporal answers remain A and lateral-motion answers remain No.
blocks.zh:
相对于默认解码,TSCD精度增益为B4DL的0.03-0.04个百分点,B4DL-Ego的0.15-0.19个百分点(表七)。 所有6个95%的场景-波斯特陷阱置信间隔都包括0个. 对于B4DL-Ego at α = 1.5\alpha = 1.5,161个错误被更正,但142个先前正确的答案变为不正确,在10,000个问题中留下19个净收益.
占主导地位的失败没有改变:时间答案仍然是A,横向运动答案仍然是No。

blocks.en: Anti-position prompting also fails to improve aggregate accuracy and reduces response validity for B4DL-Ego. An instruction to avoid positional preference does not supply the missing distinction between candidates. Since this instruction changes only multiple-choice prompts, variation in binary answers reflects the separately sampled runs rather than a change to those prompts.
blocks.zh: 反位刺激也未能提高总精度,降低B4DL-Ego的响应有效性. 避免职位偏好的指示并没有造成候选人之间缺失的区别。 由于此指示只更改多选择提示,二进制答案的变异反映了单独抽样的运行,而不是对这些提示的改变.

blocks.en: In Figure 6 , TSCD changes an incorrect spatial answer to another incorrect answer in (B), preserves a correct non-A answer in (C), and leaves the incorrect temporal choice unchanged in (D). The motion pair in (E,F) illustrate the distinction between rejecting a false relation.
blocks.zh: 在图6中,TSCD将不正确的空间答案更改为(B)中的另一个不正确的答案,保留(C)中正确的非A答案,并将不正确的时间选择保留在(D)中. 在(E,F)中的动向对说明了拒绝虚假关系之间的区别。

blocks.en: V-F Scoring and indexing checks
blocks.zh: V-F 编码和索引检查

blocks.en: Strict parsing changes fewer than 0.1% of responses and leaves the dominant answer patterns unchanged. Saved reference indices and temporal permutations are valid for the recorded feature lengths. The dominant response patterns therefore persist after correcting the identified scoring discrepancies.
blocks.zh: 严格解析的变化不到答复的0.1%,并保持主答模式不变. 保存的参考指数和时间表对记录的特征长度有效. 因此,在纠正已查明的评分差异之后,主导反应模式继续存在。

blocks.en: VI Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: What the diagnostics add. The observed errors do not follow a single preference for “No” or “A”. Multiple-choice responses favor A, lateral-motion questions receive No, and position questions often elicit false Yes answers. This task dependence matters when comparing checkpoints: a higher average can result from rejecting more false claims while detecting fewer true relations. The protocol identifies these trade-offs and the relations on which they occur. For driving-related questions, separate measures of missed objects, false assertions, and paired discrimination indicate what needs to improve, rather than treating all accuracy gains as equivalent.
blocks.zh: 诊断结果所补充的 所观察到的错误并不只局限于“否”或“A”。 多选择回答赞成A, 平级动议问题收到否, 立场问题往往引起虚假 答对. 在比较检查站时,这一任务依赖性很重要:拒绝更多的虚假主张,同时发现真实关系较少,可以导致较高的平均数。 协议确定了这些取舍及其发生关系。 对于与驾驶有关的问题,对错失的物体、虚假的断言和对等的歧视分别进行衡量,说明需要改进什么,而不是将所有准确性提高视为等效。

blocks.en: Reference quality and evaluation scope. The benchmark evaluates two configurations from one model family and inherits its temporal intervals from B4DL. Sparse returns, near-tied distances, and boundary cases warrant an independent annotation and observability audit. The motion prompts use qualitative words with threshold-based labels, so small directional changes can receive negative references. A threshold-explicit prompt evaluation would help quantify this ambiguity. Broader model coverage, option permutations, and same-checkpoint tests with and without LiDAR would further separate answer-interface effects from failures to use geometric evidence. The current experiments concern question answering, rather than closed-loop driving performance.
blocks.zh: 参考质量和评价范围。 该基准从一个模型家族评价两个配置,并从B4DL继承其时间间隔. 需要独立地进行注释和可观察性审计。 运动提示使用带有阈值标签的质词,因此小的方向变化可以收到负面引用. 快速的阈值评估将有助于量化这种模糊性。 用LiDAR进行与不使用LiDAR进行同一检查点的测试,将模型覆盖面、选择表和相同检查点的测试范围扩大,这将进一步将答案界面效应与未能使用几何证据区分开来。 目前的实验涉及回答问题,而不是闭路驾驶性能.

blocks.en: Temporal contrast and correction. TSCD rewards clean–shuffled disagreement, which helps only when that disagreement favors the correct answer. A logit component shared by both branches remains in Eq. ( 9 ), so temporal contrast alone does not remove a shared answer preference. Testing this explanation requires branch logits and matched decoding runs. In particular, α = 0 \alpha=0 , identity-permutation controls, and repeated sampling seeds would isolate the contrastive term from differences in the decoding loop and sampling.
blocks.zh: 时间对比与修正. TSCD奖励干净的分歧, 只有当分歧有利于正确答案时, 两个分支共享的对数组件仍保留在Eq. (9)中,因此仅是时间对比并不能消除共享的答案偏好. 测试此解释需要分支日志和匹配的解码运行 。 特别是α = 0\alpha=0,身份-透射控制,重复采样种子会将对比性术语从解码循环和采样的差异中分离出来.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: LiDAR-Hallu combines explicit reference-answer rules with diagnostic evaluation of LiDAR language models. Across the recorded responses, fixed-option predictions obscure weak multiple-choice performance, identical questions often fail to distinguish opposite scene relations, and true lateral-motion relations are consistently missed. The tested inference-time interventions leave these failures largely unchanged. Fixed-answer controls, paired questions, relation-specific recall, and repair counts provide a more informative account of spatio-temporal reasoning than aggregate accuracy alone.
blocks.zh: LiDAR-Hallu将明确的参考答案规则与对LiDAR语言模型的诊断评价相结合. 在整个记录的答复中,固定选项预测模糊了微弱的多选择性能,相同的问题往往无法区分相反的场景关系,真实的横向运动关系一直被忽略. 经测试的推断时间干预使这些失败基本上保持不变。 固定的回答控制,对联的问题,针对关系的召回,以及修复计数,提供了比仅综合精确性更能说明时空推理的信息.
